sourceNotes: The informal and grammatically ambiguous phrase 'Speaker of the Prophet' was repaired to the attested traditional epithet Khatib al-Anbiya, meaning orator of the prophets; Prophet Shuayb remains the supported third option.

question: According to Quran 7:85, Prophet Shuayb was sent to which people?
questionUrdu: Quran 7:85 کے مطابق Prophet Shuayb کس قوم کی طرف بھیجے گئے؟
explanationUrdu: درست جواب Madyan ہے۔ Quran 7:85 میں اہلِ مدین کی طرف ان کے بھائی شعیبؑ کو بھیجنے کا واضح ذکر موجود ہے۔

references.label: Quran 7:85
references.claimSummary: Quran 7:85 states that Shuayb was sent to the people of Madyan.

references.label: Quran 7:85 translations
references.publisher: Quranic Arabic Corpus, University of Leeds
